llanelli.snapshot: Llanelli sits in a busy South West Wales full-fibre build, with Openreach and the Welsh alt-net Ogi extending networks across the town and out into Carmarthenshire. We kit both routes the trade runs on: build contractors and structured-cabling firms that field whole crews on trade accounts, and the sole-trader broadband and CCTV installers who order direct online, with no account, and just need a few branded pieces.
llanelli.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Carmarthenshire
s1loc: Llanelli is in the middle of a steady full-fibre build. Openreach is extending its Full Fibre network across the SA14 and SA15 areas and out through Carmarthenshire, while Ogi, the Welsh alternative network, is building its own fibre across the county and Virgin Media keeps upgrading on top. Crews work through Llwynhendy, Bynea, Felinfoel, Dafen, Pwll and Furnace, threading fibre through streets, chambers and cabinets, and a long tail of broadband, CCTV and structured-cabling installers takes on the connections street by street across the town.

Alongside the residential rollout runs a real commercial scene. The Tata Steel tinplate works at Trostre is the town's industrial anchor, and the Dafen and Trostre industrial estates, Llanelli Gate Business Park and the Parc Trostre and Pemberton retail parks all need structured cabling, fibre and CCTV. Coleg Sir Gar, the schools and the multi-site businesses across the town add data-cabling and access-control work in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre. Local cabling and security installers wire those premises for businesses right across Llanelli and the wider Carmarthenshire coast.
